beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: An array is dots in equal rows. Three rows, four dots in each row.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twelve dots in all. Rows times dots in each row gives the total.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six times a box equals forty-two. The box stands for a missing number.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Does forty-two go in the box?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forty-two is the whole array. We need how many dots belong in each of six rows.

do.text: The box: dots in each row

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Start with one dot per row: six dots. Each new column adds six more. Stop at forty-two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twelve.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eighteen.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Twenty-four.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Thirty.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Thirty-six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forty-two. Exactly.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count across one row: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seven in every row! So seven goes in the box.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forty-two divided into six equal rows also asks how many in each row. Seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Box times ten equals ninety. This time, ten is in each row. How many rows?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count tens until ninety: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Nine rows of ten. The box is nine, not ninety.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Seventy-two divided by a box equals eight. Seventy-two dots, eight in each row. What is hidden?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The number of rows. How many eights make seventy-two?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight, sixteen, twenty-four, thirty-two, forty, forty-eight, fifty-six, sixty-four, seventy-two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Nine rows. Check: nine times eight makes seventy-two. Seventy-two divided by nine is eight.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One array, three numbers. Hide how many are in each row.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: It's seven.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Forty-two dots, with six in every column. How many columns?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Seven again!

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Hide the total.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six rows of seven give forty-two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Hide the rows. Forty-two in groups of seven makes how many rows?

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Six.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The box is a number the other two already decide.
